subject: Implement pre-tool-call budget hook (soft + hard cap behavior)
description:
Build `capo/budget/hooks.py` — pre-`agent.run` and pre-`delegate_*` hook that consults the accountant and applies soft/hard cap behavior per §5.9. Implements the override flow and a `budget_overrides(date, user_id)` table (added in this task's migration).

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Hook runs BEFORE every `agent.run` and every `delegate_*` call.
- [ ] **Soft cap**: when day's total > `budget.soft_daily_usd`, swap `config.models.default` → `config.models.router` in-memory for remainder of day; send a one-line heads-up via AMC to `budget.notify_channel`. Heads-up is sent at most once per day.
- [ ] **Hard cap**: when day's total > `budget.hard_daily_usd`, `capo.run` short-circuits with "budget exceeded — reply 'override' to continue today" message.
- [ ] Dispatcher pre-parses inbound text for case-insensitive exact `override` or slash command `/override` BEFORE the agent loop. On match, INSERT a row in `budget_overrides(date, user_id)` scoped to the current `user_id`; this unlocks the rest of the day; resets at local midnight.
- [ ] When `budget.enforcement_enabled = false` (per §11.2), hook is a no-op.
- [ ] Emits `capo.budget.cap` Logfire spans on soft/hard hits per §6.5.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] User sends override BEFORE hard cap fires: row inserted but no effect until/unless cap fires.
- [ ] Two users on the same Capo: override is scoped per `user_id`.

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Accountant read failure: hook fails OPEN (allow the call) and logs a Logfire error.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: synthetic accumulation crosses soft cap → model swap verified
• Integration: synthetic accumulation crosses hard cap → override flow verified
• Integration: midnight reset clears soft and hard cap effects

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.9, 6.5, 9.5, 11.2
